title: Falcon Heavy & Starman
summary: SpaceX's recap of the Falcon Heavy debut launch, with side booster landings and a Tesla Roadster with Starman sent into orbit.
why: HN references it for launch footage and the atmosphere of the first Falcon Heavy flight, including the center core landing failure.
